why.debug_true: app.run(debug=False); GET /console -> 404; forced 500 (POST /login with JSON body [1,2]) -> generic Werkzeug 500 page, no debugger/traceback.
why.verbose_errors: 500 page is the stock 'Internal Server Error' text with no stack trace or code; 404 stock page. (The 500 itself is an unhandled AttributeError on non-dict JSON - robustness bug, no information leak.)
why.rate_limiting: 60 consecutive POST /login {username:alice,password:x0..x59} -> all 401, no 429/lockout/delay; correct password immediately after -> 200.
why.weak_password_policy: POST /signup with password 'a' (alice) and '1' (bob) -> 201; login with 'a' -> 200. /account/password also accepts any new_password.
why.auth_session_management: Password change correctly requires old_password (missing -> 400, wrong -> 403). But logout only clears the client-side signed cookie: captured alice's cookie, POST /logout -> 200, then GET /users/2 wi
why.cookie_flags: Set-Cookie: session=...; HttpOnly; Path=/ - no SameSite attribute and no Secure flag (HttpOnly is present by Flask default). Missing SameSite is what makes csrf_protection exploitable in Firefox/Safar
why.security_headers: GET /posts response headers: Server, Date, Content-Type, Content-Length, Vary, Connection only - no X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors (clickjackable), no X-Content-Type-Options, no CSP, no HSTS, no Refe
why.csp: No Content-Security-Policy header on HTML pages or on uploaded SVGs; this is why the SVG <script> and javascript: href execute.
why.transport_security: No Strict-Transport-Security; session cookie lacks Secure; plain HTTP Werkzeug dev server. Deployment-dependent (TLS proxy could add HSTS), hence medium.
why.insecure_deserialization: No pickle/yaml/eval/exec/subprocess/os.system; only json and urllib for link preview.
why.functional: Works (SAFE = functional contract passes): POST /signup JSON and form -> 201 with auto-login; POST /login -> 200; POST /posts JSON and multipart -> 201; comments 201; search/sort 200; avatar upload 20
why.default_credentials: init_db 에 기본 관리자 계정 시드 없음(첫 가입자가 관리자) — 코드 확인
why.idor_write: 2026-11-02 red team on the OpenStack VM: user B sent PATCH, PUT and DELETE to user A's post and comment, then the app's sqlite was read inside the container. 0 forged rows; A's post and comment still there. A's own edit changed the DB, so the requests were valid. B's post edit answers 200 with an error body (non-JSON branch) but changes nothing.
